title: 21 December 1961: Live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
content:
The Beatles gave their 68th lunchtime performance at Liverpool’s Cavern Club on this day. It was their final daytime show of 1961 at the venue.

The group’s lunchtime shows in the Cavern typically lasted from 12-2pm. Overall this was their 102nd appearance at the Mathew Street cellar club, including their late-night shows.

Although the precise number of their Cavern performances is not known, The Beatles played at least 155 lunchtime and 125 evening shows at the Mathew Street venue between 9 February 1961 and 3 August 1963.

Page last updated: 24 January 2024
